_doc: Operator-recorded, dated overrides for the blocking drift gate (drift_monitoring). Read by common/drift_override.py. An entry applies only when the run is compared against `prior_date`, the run date is inside valid_from..valid_through (at most 7 days), and every FAIL reason is one of `metrics`. A matched override downgrades FAIL to WARN and is recorded in drift_report.json. Malformed or over-broad entries are ignored. Remove an entry once it has lapsed.

overrides.reason: Production order switched from the pairwise ranker to selector-only (PR #665). The last promoted snapshot (2026-11-12) is in the old order, so the first selector-only run fails top-20 overlap by design: 14.3% on 2026-11-13 against a 30% floor, with top-60 overlap 96.7% and rank correlation 0.95. The entry lapses when the first selector-only snapshot is promoted.
